mapper.select: SELECT m.menu_id, m.menu_name, m.menu_name_en, m.menu_type, m.price, m.category, m.image_url, m.description, m.description_en, m.is_available, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM menu_set ms JOIN menus component ON component.menu_id = ms.component_menu_id WHERE ms.set_menu_id = m.menu_id AND ms.select_group IS NULL AND ( component.is_available = FALSE OR component.is_visible = FALSE ) ) THEN FALSE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT ms.select_group FROM menu_set ms JOIN menus component ON component.menu_id = ms.component_menu_id WHERE ms.set_menu_id = m.menu_id AND ms.select_group IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ms.select_group HAVING SUM( CASE WHEN component.is_available = TRUE AND component.is_visible = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) = 0 ) THEN FALSE ELSE m.is_available END AS effective_available, m.is_visible, m.sold_out_reason, m.created_at, m.updated_at FROM menus m ORDER BY m.menu_id ASC

SELECT m.menu_id, m.menu_name, m.menu_name_en, m.menu_type, m.price, m.category, m.image_url, m.description, m.description_en, m.is_available, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM menu_set ms JOIN menus component ON component.menu_id = ms.component_menu_id WHERE ms.set_menu_id = m.menu_id AND ms.select_group IS NULL AND ( component.is_available = FALSE OR component.is_visible = FALSE ) ) THEN FALSE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT ms.select_group FROM menu_set ms JOIN menus component ON component.menu_id = ms.component_menu_id WHERE ms.set_menu_id = m.menu_id AND ms.select_group IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ms.select_group HAVING SUM( CASE WHEN component.is_available = TRUE AND component.is_visible = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) = 0 ) THEN FALSE ELSE m.is_available END AS effective_available, m.is_visible, m.sold_out_reason, m.created_at, m.updated_at FROM menus m WHERE m.menu_id = #{menuId}

SELECT component.menu_id AS componentMenuId, component.menu_name AS menuName, component.menu_name_en AS menuNameEn, component.category, component.is_available AS isAvailable, component.is_visible AS isVisible, ms.select_group AS selectGroup, ms.group_max_select AS groupMaxSelect, COALESCE(ms.extra_price, 0) AS extraPrice FROM menu_set ms JOIN menus component ON component.menu_id = ms.component_menu_id WHERE ms.set_menu_id = #{menuId} ORDER BY component.menu_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO menu_set ( set_menu_id, component_menu_id, select_group, group_max_select, extra_price ) VALUES ( #{setMenuId}, #{componentMenuId}, NULLIF(#{selectGroup}, ''), #{groupMaxSelect}, COALESCE(#{extraPrice}, 0) )

INSERT INTO menus ( menu_name, menu_name_en, menu_type, price, category, image_url, description, description_en, is_available, is_visible, sold_out_reason ) VALUES ( #{menuName}, #{menuNameEn}, #{menuType}, #{price}, #{category}, #{imageUrl}, #{description}, #{descriptionEn}, #{isAvailable}, true, #{soldOutReason} )
mapper.update:
UPDATE menus
menu_name = #{menuName}, menu_name_en = #{menuNameEn}, menu_type = #{menuType}, price = #{price}, category = #{category},
image_url = #{imageUrl},
description = #{description}, description_en = #{descriptionEn}, is_available = #{isAvailable}, sold_out_reason = #{soldOutReason}, updated_at = NOW()
WHERE menu_id = #{menuId}
UPDATE menus SET is_visible = false, is_available = false, updated_at = NOW() WHERE menu_id = #{menuId}
UPDATE menus SET is_visible = true, is_available = true, sold_out_reason = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE menu_id = #{menuId}
